verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS meeting-notes tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions source code, a public repository, or an open license. The pack covers only a proprietary REST API, webhooks, an MCP server and product features, none of which count as readable source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
